description: Institutional AI decision ontology derived and normalized from the curated corpus, CaRCC AI Facilitation Handbook, and MS-CC primary materials.

decisions.question: What institutional outcomes should AI adoption be expected to advance?
decisions.trigger: Any institution beginning or resetting AI planning
decisions.context_variables: Mission; strategic plan; current AI use; leadership priorities; budget
decisions.options: Research capacity | teaching and learning | student services | administrative efficiency | workforce productivity | combinations
decisions.recommendation_logic: Prioritize outcomes that align with institutional mission and can be measured; avoid technology-first adoption.
decisions.stakeholders: President; Provost; CIO; VPR; Faculty leadership
decisions.decision_output: Document 3–5 institutional AI objectives and success measures.

decisions.question: Where is AI already being used across the institution?
decisions.trigger: AI use is occurring informally or across multiple units
decisions.context_variables: Departments; tools; users; data types; vendors; use cases
decisions.options: Central inventory | distributed inventory | targeted inventory of higher-risk uses
decisions.recommendation_logic: Inventory current use before setting broad policy or procurement priorities.
decisions.primary_risks: Shadow AI; duplicated spend; unknown risk
decisions.stakeholders: CIO; IT; Provost; Research; HR; Procurement
decisions.decision_output: Create a use-case and tool inventory.

decisions.question: Which AI use cases should be piloted, scaled, paused, or prohibited?
decisions.trigger: More proposed AI uses than available capacity
decisions.context_variables: Impact; risk; cost; data sensitivity; reversibility; staffing
decisions.options: Pilot | scale | pause | prohibit
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use impact-versus-risk and capacity criteria rather than popularity or vendor pressure.
decisions.stakeholders: AI governance body; CIO; Provost; functional owners
decisions.decision_output: Rank AI use cases with rationale.

decisions.question: Should the institution govern only generative AI or AI/ML/LLMs more broadly?
decisions.trigger: Drafting or revising institutional AI policy
decisions.context_variables: Existing tools; research activity; embedded vendor AI; governance capacity
decisions.options: GenAI only | AI broadly | AI+ML+LLM explicitly | phased scope
decisions.recommendation_logic: Broader scope reduces gaps created by embedded AI, but a phased approach may fit institutions with limited capacity.
decisions.stakeholders: Legal; CIO; Provost; Research; Faculty governance
decisions.decision_output: Define technologies and contexts covered by policy.

decisions.question: Should the institution build, buy, partner, or share AI capabilities?
decisions.trigger: Need exceeds local staffing, infrastructure, or budget
decisions.context_variables: Institution size; staffing; contracts; consortia; research intensity; data sensitivity
decisions.options: Build | buy | consortium/shared service | hybrid
decisions.recommendation_logic: Smaller or capacity-constrained institutions should explicitly consider shared expertise and infrastructure rather than replicate everything locally.

decisions.question: What evidence is required before making a major AI investment?
decisions.trigger: Large procurement, infrastructure purchase, or platform commitment
decisions.context_variables: TCO; utilization; alternatives; pilot outcomes; security; accessibility; exit plan
decisions.options: Pilot evidence | business case | risk review | executive approval
decisions.recommendation_logic: Require proportionate evidence and exit criteria before irreversible or high-cost commitments.

decisions.question: What governance structure should oversee institutional AI?
decisions.trigger: AI affects multiple units or material risk
decisions.context_variables: Existing committees; institution size; decision rights; staffing
decisions.options: New AI council | existing committee | distributed model | temporary task force
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use the lightest structure that still creates clear accountability, cross-functional review, and decision rights.
decisions.stakeholders: Provost; CIO; Legal; Faculty; Privacy; Research

decisions.question: Which AI decisions require central approval versus local discretion?
decisions.trigger: Governance body exists or decentralized adoption is occurring
decisions.context_variables: Risk level; data sensitivity; dollar threshold; population affected
decisions.options: Central approval | delegated approval | local discretion with standards
decisions.recommendation_logic: Centralize high-risk, high-cost, data-sensitive and institution-wide decisions; delegate low-risk experimentation within guardrails.

decisions.question: Who must be represented in AI governance and policy development?
decisions.trigger: Creating governance body or major policy
decisions.context_variables: Students; faculty; IT; privacy; disability; library; research; HR; procurement
decisions.options: Standing representatives | rotating members | advisory network
decisions.recommendation_logic: Include affected communities and the offices that must operationalize decisions, not just technologists.
decisions.primary_risks: Blind spots; low trust; unusable policy
decisions.stakeholders: Board; Leadership; Faculty; Students; CIO/CISO; Library; Privacy; Disability

decisions.question: Who is accountable for each deployed AI system or use case?
decisions.trigger: An AI system is approved for use
decisions.context_variables: Business owner; technical owner; data owner; vendor; end users
decisions.options: Named accountable executive | service owner | distributed ownership with RACI
decisions.recommendation_logic: Every material AI use needs a named owner responsible for outcomes, controls, and remediation.
decisions.stakeholders: Functional owner; CIO; Risk; Vendor manager

decisions.question: How will users report problems and influence AI policy or services?
decisions.trigger: AI service or policy is live
decisions.context_variables: User populations; support channels; governance cadence
decisions.options: Help desk | surveys | governance intake | community forum | multiple channels
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use accessible recurring mechanisms and feed findings into policy/service review.
decisions.decision_output: Establish feedback channels and review cadence.

decisions.question: How often should AI policies and controls be reviewed?
decisions.trigger: Policy or major AI service is active
decisions.context_variables: Rate of technology change; regulation; incidents; vendor changes
decisions.options: Annual | biannual | event-triggered + annual | continuous standards with periodic policy review
decisions.recommendation_logic: Treat AI policy as a living system; review at least annually and after material incidents or vendor/model changes.

decisions.question: Which AI-supported decisions must remain under explicit human review and approval?
decisions.trigger: AI influences consequential decisions or autonomous actions
decisions.context_variables: Decision impact; reversibility; legal duties; affected populations
decisions.options: Human-in-the-loop | human-on-the-loop | automation allowed only for low consequence
decisions.recommendation_logic: Keep human accountability for consequential institutional decisions and clearly define automation limits.

decisions.question: What uses of AI are acceptable, restricted, or prohibited for each campus population?
decisions.trigger: AI tools are available to faculty, staff, students or researchers
decisions.context_variables: Population; data type; task; consequence; tool class
decisions.options: Allowed | allowed with conditions | restricted | prohibited
decisions.recommendation_logic: Write use-based rules tied to risk and data, not vague blanket statements.

decisions.question: When must an alternative non-AI workflow be available?
decisions.trigger: AI is used in classrooms, meetings, services, or required workflows
decisions.context_variables: Accessibility; consent; educational purpose; operational feasibility
decisions.options: Always | defined contexts | case-by-case | no opt-out where legally/operationally required
decisions.recommendation_logic: Document where opt-out is meaningful and what alternative exists.
decisions.stakeholders: Disability services; Faculty; HR; Students; Legal

decisions.question: How should AI use cases be classified by risk?
decisions.trigger: More than trivial experimentation or multiple AI uses
decisions.context_variables: Data sensitivity; decision impact; autonomy; scale; user population
decisions.options: Low/medium/high | tiered risk model | domain-specific model
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use a consistent risk model to determine review depth and controls.
decisions.decision_output: Adopt risk-tier definitions and required controls.

decisions.question: Should the institution rely on vendor risk models or maintain its own?
decisions.trigger: Vendors provide proprietary assurance/risk frameworks
decisions.context_variables: Internal expertise; regulatory exposure; vendor diversity
decisions.options: Vendor model | institutional model | institutional baseline + vendor evidence
decisions.recommendation_logic: Maintain institutional criteria even when vendor frameworks are used as evidence.

decisions.question: Which laws, sponsor rules, and institutional policies apply to each AI use?
decisions.trigger: AI handles regulated data, research, students, employees or decisions
decisions.context_variables: FERPA; HIPAA; PHI; CUI; GDPR; state law; IRB; sponsor rules; contracts
decisions.options: Compliance mapping by use case
decisions.recommendation_logic: Route each use through existing regulatory and policy frameworks; AI does not replace them.
decisions.decision_output: Create compliance checklist by use case.

decisions.question: What AI uses are permitted in proposals, research conduct, analysis, writing, and peer review?
decisions.trigger: Researchers are using AI in funded or publishable work
decisions.context_variables: Sponsor rules; journal rules; human subjects; data restrictions; disclosure
decisions.options: Allowed with disclosure | restricted by stage | sponsor/journal-specific
decisions.recommendation_logic: Anchor rules to sponsor, journal, integrity, privacy, and reproducibility requirements.
decisions.stakeholders: VPR; Sponsored Programs; Research Integrity; Faculty

decisions.question: What counts as an AI-related incident requiring response?
decisions.trigger: AI systems are deployed or integrated
decisions.context_variables: Data breach; harmful output; model drift; misuse; unauthorized automation; policy violation
decisions.options: Defined severity tiers
decisions.recommendation_logic: Define incident categories and escalation thresholds before an incident occurs.
decisions.decision_output: Add AI incident taxonomy to IR plan.

decisions.question: Can AI features, models, accounts, or integrations be disabled quickly during an incident?
decisions.trigger: Institution relies on AI features or vendor integrations
decisions.context_variables: Admin control; vendor console; on-prem controls; dependencies
decisions.options: Central kill switch | account suspension | isolation/quarantine | vendor escalation
decisions.recommendation_logic: Require practical disablement paths proportionate to system criticality.

decisions.question: What AI-specific terms must be present in contracts and service agreements?
decisions.trigger: Procuring or renewing AI-enabled services
decisions.context_variables: Data ownership; training use; breach notice; retention; audit; subprocessors; jurisdiction
decisions.options: Standard contract addendum | service-specific negotiated clauses
decisions.recommendation_logic: Explicitly address institutional data use, sensitive data, incident reporting, sovereignty, retention and model training.

decisions.question: How should AI-related data be classified for handling and storage?
decisions.trigger: AI uses institutional, research, student, employee, or generated data
decisions.context_variables: Training/test/inference/output; sensitivity; regulation; ownership
decisions.options: Existing data classes extended to AI | AI-specific categories
decisions.recommendation_logic: Map AI artifacts to existing data classifications and add AI-specific categories where needed.
decisions.decision_output: Define AI data categories and handling rules.

decisions.question: May sensitive or regulated data be entered into public/consumer AI services?
decisions.trigger: Users can access public AI tools
decisions.context_variables: Data type; vendor terms; enterprise protections; consent
decisions.options: Prohibit | allow only de-identified | approved enterprise service only
decisions.recommendation_logic: Default to approved environments for sensitive data unless contract and controls clearly permit otherwise.

decisions.question: Who owns or controls data used for AI, and are permissions sufficient for the intended use?
decisions.trigger: AI project acquires or reuses datasets
decisions.context_variables: Ownership; DUA; consent; license; Indigenous governance; sponsor rules
decisions.options: Use | seek permission | restrict | do not use
decisions.recommendation_logic: Resolve ownership and permissions before model development or procurement commitments.

decisions.question: May vendors use institutional prompts, files, or outputs to train their models?
decisions.trigger: Using third-party AI
decisions.context_variables: Contract terms; account type; data sensitivity
decisions.options: No training | opt-out | consent-based | allowed for public/non-sensitive only
decisions.recommendation_logic: Require explicit terms rather than assumptions about provider behavior.

decisions.question: Where may institutional AI data be stored and processed?
decisions.trigger: Cloud/vendor services cross jurisdictions or involve governed data
decisions.context_variables: Jurisdiction; contracts; Indigenous data governance; research restrictions
decisions.options: On-prem | approved region | vendor global processing | case-specific
decisions.recommendation_logic: Set residency/sovereignty constraints based on legal, contractual and community obligations.

decisions.question: Which storage platforms are approved for AI data and model artifacts?
decisions.trigger: AI projects need storage
decisions.context_variables: Data sensitivity; performance; audit; encryption; cost; residency
decisions.options: Campus storage | institutional cloud | object store | parallel FS | hybrid
decisions.recommendation_logic: Approve storage by data class and workload, not convenience alone.

decisions.question: How long should AI datasets, prompts, logs, checkpoints, models, and outputs be retained?
decisions.trigger: AI artifacts accumulate or project ends
decisions.context_variables: Records policy; sponsor; reproducibility; privacy; storage cost
decisions.options: Retention schedule by artifact class
decisions.recommendation_logic: Apply records and research requirements while defining secure deletion/de-provisioning for AI artifacts.

decisions.question: How should AI data move between campus, cloud, collaborators, and compute systems?
decisions.trigger: Data must move between environments
decisions.context_variables: Sensitivity; size; external collaborators; auditability
decisions.options: Approved managed transfer | encrypted API | secure enclave | prohibit movement
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use authenticated, auditable transfer methods matched to data sensitivity and scale.

decisions.question: What minimum data quality checks are required before model development or deployment?
decisions.trigger: Training/evaluation uses institutional or research data
decisions.context_variables: Completeness; bias; outliers; representativeness; provenance
decisions.options: Project-specific acceptance criteria | standard QA checklist
decisions.recommendation_logic: Define quality and representativeness criteria before modeling; poor data propagates downstream.

decisions.question: How will transformations and versions of training/evaluation data be tracked?
decisions.trigger: Data changes over project lifecycle
decisions.context_variables: Team size; regulated data; reproducibility requirements
decisions.options: DVC/versioned storage | immutable snapshots | documented manual versions
decisions.recommendation_logic: Track data transformations and versions from the start for reproducibility and auditability.

decisions.question: Who should have access to AI tools, models, data, and compute resources?
decisions.trigger: Providing shared AI services or restricted data access
decisions.context_variables: Role; data sensitivity; project membership; cost; licensing
decisions.options: RBAC | project groups | quotas | approval-based access
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use least privilege and role/project-based access tied to data and resource sensitivity.
decisions.stakeholders: CISO; IAM; Research IT; Service owner

decisions.question: How should scarce AI compute be allocated fairly?
decisions.trigger: Shared GPU/CPU resources are constrained
decisions.context_variables: Research priority; class use; grant obligations; user population
decisions.options: Fair share | quotas | reservations | priority queues
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use transparent allocation rules and prevent resource concentration that deepens inequity.

decisions.question: What authentication requirements should apply to AI services and models?
decisions.trigger: AI systems expose APIs, interfaces or privileged capabilities
decisions.context_variables: SSO; MFA; external collaborators; service accounts
decisions.options: SSO/MFA | federated identity | project credentials | local accounts only when necessary
decisions.recommendation_logic: Integrate with institutional identity where feasible and minimize unmanaged accounts.

decisions.question: What AI actions, model versions, data access, and administrative changes must be logged?
decisions.trigger: AI systems are operational
decisions.context_variables: Risk level; privacy; incident needs; reproducibility
decisions.options: Security logs | model audit logs | prompt/action logs | data access logs
decisions.recommendation_logic: Collect logs sufficient for security, accountability and reproducibility while considering privacy.

decisions.question: How will models be authenticated, tested, and monitored for anomalies or misuse?
decisions.trigger: Institution develops or hosts models
decisions.context_variables: Model provenance; update source; performance; threat model
decisions.options: Signed/verified models | validation pipeline | periodic audits
decisions.recommendation_logic: Treat models as governed software artifacts with provenance, testing and monitoring.

decisions.question: When are adversarial testing and defenses required?
decisions.trigger: High-impact models, exposed APIs, or untrusted input
decisions.context_variables: Threat exposure; decision impact; public access
decisions.options: Baseline testing | red-team | adversarial robustness tools | not required for low-risk sandbox
decisions.recommendation_logic: Apply proportionate adversarial testing to externally exposed or consequential systems.

decisions.question: Does a project require an isolated or controlled computing environment?
decisions.trigger: PII/PHI/CUI/IRB/DUA or other restricted data is involved
decisions.context_variables: Data classification; sponsor; collaboration; software needs
decisions.options: Secure enclave | regulated cloud | controlled HPC | standard environment
decisions.recommendation_logic: Map compliance requirements to an approved technical environment before data movement or training.

decisions.question: What type of AI workload is being supported?
decisions.trigger: Planning AI infrastructure or service
decisions.context_variables: Training; fine-tuning; inference; agentic; generative; batch/interactive/realtime
decisions.options: Classify by workload and execution mode
decisions.recommendation_logic: Different workloads have materially different compute, storage, security, and governance needs.

decisions.question: What CPU, GPU, memory, storage, and network resources are actually required?
decisions.trigger: Project or platform requests compute
decisions.context_variables: Dataset/model size; concurrency; latency; training duration; utilization
decisions.options: Local | HPC | cloud | hybrid | external shared resource
decisions.recommendation_logic: Estimate from workload and success criteria before acquiring resources.
decisions.decision_output: Produce resource estimate and capacity plan.

decisions.question: Should an AI workload run on local, institutional, cloud, or hybrid infrastructure?
decisions.trigger: Resource plan or deployment model is undecided
decisions.context_variables: Data sensitivity; elasticity; utilization; egress; staffing; grants; latency
decisions.options: On-prem | cloud | hybrid | national/shared infrastructure
decisions.recommendation_logic: Balance privacy, scale, utilization, skills, and full lifecycle cost; avoid ideology about cloud or local hardware.

decisions.question: Should the institution purchase dedicated GPU infrastructure?
decisions.trigger: Demand for GPUs is recurring or politically attractive
decisions.context_variables: Utilization forecast; staffing; facility capacity; cloud/shared alternatives; refresh cycle
decisions.options: Buy | lease/cloud | use NAIRR/shared | hybrid
decisions.recommendation_logic: Purchase only when sustained demand, operations capability, and TCO justify ownership.

decisions.question: Should the institution operate a shared AI platform rather than project-by-project environments?
decisions.trigger: Multiple teams need similar AI capabilities
decisions.context_variables: Demand; support staff; security baselines; model serving; notebooks; data platforms
decisions.options: Shared platform | project environments | managed vendor platform | hybrid
decisions.recommendation_logic: Shared platforms can reduce duplication but require product-level ownership and lifecycle support.

decisions.question: How should AI software, libraries, plugins, and model-serving tools be approved and maintained?
decisions.trigger: Users install rapidly changing AI stacks
decisions.context_variables: Security; licenses; compatibility; insurance; support
decisions.options: Central catalog | managed environments | request-based approval | sandbox exceptions
decisions.recommendation_logic: Centralize lifecycle and risk controls while preserving sandbox paths for legitimate research experimentation.

decisions.question: When should AI workloads be containerized?
decisions.trigger: Moving workloads across HPC/cloud or deploying services
decisions.context_variables: Portability; dependencies; security; reproducibility
decisions.options: Container required for deployment | recommended for research | exceptions
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use containers when portability, repeatability, or operational deployment matters.

decisions.question: Which execution mode does the use case require?
decisions.trigger: Model application is being designed
decisions.context_variables: Latency; user concurrency; predictability; hardware; safety
decisions.options: Batch | interactive | real-time
decisions.recommendation_logic: Choose the simplest mode that meets scientific/operational requirements; real-time adds substantial complexity.

decisions.question: When should a prototype move from laptop/Colab to shared or institutional resources?
decisions.trigger: Prototype is growing
decisions.context_variables: Dataset size; runtime; reliability; concurrency; compliance; cost
decisions.options: Stay local | move to shared HPC | cloud | production platform
decisions.recommendation_logic: Scale when local constraints, reliability, compliance, or collaboration make the prototype environment unsuitable.

decisions.question: Who will maintain an AI environment or service after the pilot or grant ends?
decisions.trigger: Pilot may become recurring service
decisions.context_variables: Funding; staffing; ownership; refresh; vendor terms; user base
decisions.options: Retire | hand off | institutionalize | externally host
decisions.recommendation_logic: Decide support and lifecycle model before production commitments.

decisions.question: Which existing vendors have added AI features to products already in use?
decisions.trigger: Renewals or product updates introduce AI
decisions.context_variables: Application portfolio; feature flags; data access; contract change
decisions.options: Inventory + review | block feature | accept low-risk feature
decisions.recommendation_logic: Treat embedded vendor AI as a new capability requiring review, not merely a normal upgrade.
decisions.decision_output: Maintain inventory of embedded AI features.

decisions.question: What minimum due diligence is required before approving an AI vendor or feature?
decisions.trigger: New AI purchase, renewal, or material feature
decisions.context_variables: Data practices; security; model behavior; accessibility; compliance; TCO; exit
decisions.options: Standard questionnaire | HECVAT + AI addendum | enhanced review for high risk
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use consistent institutional criteria and increase scrutiny with risk.

decisions.question: Should the institution build a solution, configure an existing platform, or buy a specialized product?
decisions.trigger: Use case has multiple solution paths
decisions.context_variables: Differentiation; staffing; integration; data sensitivity; maintenance; cost
decisions.options: Build | configure | buy | shared/open-source
decisions.recommendation_logic: Favor the least operationally burdensome option that meets institutional requirements; build only when differentiation or constraints justify it.

decisions.question: Can the institution leave the vendor without losing data, workflows, or critical functionality?
decisions.trigger: Entering a strategic AI contract
decisions.context_variables: Data export; model portability; integrations; contract term; switching cost
decisions.options: Documented exit | migration plan | contractual portability
decisions.recommendation_logic: Require practical exit and deletion provisions for strategic services.

decisions.question: Has the AI product been evaluated for accessibility and accommodation needs?
decisions.trigger: AI will be used by broad campus populations
decisions.context_variables: VPAT; actual testing; disability feedback; alternative workflow
decisions.options: Approve | approve with remediation | reject | pilot with accommodations
decisions.recommendation_logic: Accessibility belongs in selection, not post-purchase cleanup.

decisions.question: What is the full lifecycle cost of the AI service or infrastructure?
decisions.trigger: Comparing cloud, vendor, or on-prem options
decisions.context_variables: License; compute; storage; egress; staffing; support; facilities; refresh; training
decisions.options: 3–5 year TCO scenarios
decisions.recommendation_logic: Compare lifecycle cost and utilization rather than sticker price.

decisions.question: What AI literacy should every faculty member, staff member, student, and leader possess?
decisions.trigger: Institution supports broad AI use
decisions.context_variables: Role; risk; discipline; current skill; policy obligations
decisions.options: Common baseline + role-specific modules
decisions.recommendation_logic: Establish a common responsible-use baseline, then deepen training by role and risk.
decisions.stakeholders: HR; Teaching center; IT; Library; Student affairs

decisions.question: Which populations and skills should be trained first?
decisions.trigger: Training demand exceeds capacity
decisions.context_variables: Survey demand; high-risk roles; current adoption; strategic priorities
decisions.options: Leadership first | faculty first | staff first | researchers first | risk-based sequencing
decisions.recommendation_logic: Prioritize high-use/high-risk populations and areas with demonstrated demand.

decisions.question: How should AI training be delivered and refreshed?
decisions.trigger: AI literacy program is being designed
decisions.context_variables: Population size; bandwidth; turnover; skill depth
decisions.options: Async | workshops | courses | orientations | communities of practice | mixed
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use recurring, multimodal training rather than one-off events.

decisions.question: Where do users go for AI help?
decisions.trigger: AI use is institutionally supported
decisions.context_variables: Help desk skills; library; RCD; teaching center; research office
decisions.options: Central AI help | federated support | tiered routing | community of practice
decisions.recommendation_logic: Create clear routing even if expertise is distributed.

decisions.question: Does the institution need dedicated AI/RCD facilitation capability?
decisions.trigger: Researchers struggle to translate AI ideas into feasible projects
decisions.context_variables: Research volume; HPC/cloud access; data complexity; staffing
decisions.options: Dedicated facilitator | shared regional role | cross-trained existing staff | external partner
decisions.recommendation_logic: Where research demand exists, facilitation can be more valuable than simply buying compute.

decisions.question: Should specialized AI/HPC/security expertise be shared across institutions?
decisions.trigger: Small institution lacks full-time specialists
decisions.context_variables: Consortium relationships; demand; service boundaries; funding
decisions.options: Shared role | pooled team | consulting agreement | local hire
decisions.recommendation_logic: Shared models are credible when demand is intermittent or local hiring is unrealistic.

decisions.question: Should the institution maintain an AI community of practice or mentoring network?
decisions.trigger: AI knowledge is distributed and changing rapidly
decisions.context_variables: Campus culture; champions; geographic distribution; existing groups
decisions.options: Community of practice | faculty fellows | mentoring | no formal group
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use communities to share practice and surface policy issues, but connect them to formal governance/support.

decisions.question: Which work should AI augment, automate, or leave human-led?
decisions.trigger: Units propose AI for administrative work
decisions.context_variables: Task repetitiveness; consequence; judgment; privacy; workforce agreements
decisions.options: Augment | automate low-risk steps | redesign workflow | no AI
decisions.recommendation_logic: Evaluate work at task level and retain human responsibility for consequential judgment.

decisions.question: What AI use rules should be communicated at course and assignment level?
decisions.trigger: Students use AI in coursework
decisions.context_variables: Learning outcomes; discipline; assignment type; accessibility
decisions.options: Allowed | allowed with disclosure | restricted | prohibited by assignment
decisions.recommendation_logic: Make expectations explicit and tied to learning goals rather than universal bans.

decisions.question: Which assessments should be redesigned because generative AI changes what they measure?
decisions.trigger: Existing assessments can be trivially completed by AI or no longer demonstrate learning
decisions.context_variables: Learning outcome; authenticity; accessibility; scale
decisions.options: Oral/video defense | process evidence | applied tasks | controlled assessment | retain current
decisions.recommendation_logic: Redesign where AI undermines validity; do not redesign solely to police tool use.

decisions.question: When should students disclose or document AI assistance?
decisions.trigger: AI is permitted in coursework
decisions.context_variables: Assignment purpose; contribution level; citation norms
decisions.options: Always disclose | disclose substantive use | assignment-specific
decisions.recommendation_logic: Set disclosure rules that support learning and integrity, with examples.

decisions.question: Should AI-detection tools be used in academic integrity processes?
decisions.trigger: Faculty seek enforcement tools
decisions.context_variables: Tool validity; due process; false positives; institutional policy
decisions.options: Do not use as sole evidence | limited investigative signal | prohibit
decisions.recommendation_logic: Do not treat imperfect detection as definitive evidence; use holistic integrity processes.

decisions.question: How should embedded AI in LMS, adaptive learning, grading, advising, or library systems be disclosed and governed?
decisions.trigger: Vendor systems add AI functionality
decisions.context_variables: Student data; decision impact; transparency; opt-out; accessibility
decisions.options: Enable | pilot | restrict | disable feature
decisions.recommendation_logic: Treat embedded AI as an institutional use case with privacy, accessibility, and transparency review.
decisions.decision_output: Inventory and review student-facing embedded AI.

decisions.question: What should students learn about AI before graduation?
decisions.trigger: AI affects academic and professional practice
decisions.context_variables: Discipline; program outcomes; employer needs; ethics
decisions.options: Institution-wide outcome | program outcome | elective modules
decisions.recommendation_logic: Teach practical, critical, ethical use rather than prompt tricks alone.

decisions.question: When should students participate in AI policy and service design?
decisions.trigger: AI directly affects student learning or services
decisions.context_variables: Impact; representation; governance structure
decisions.options: Standing representation | consultation | pilot feedback
decisions.recommendation_logic: Include students in decisions that materially affect learning, access, integrity, and services.

decisions.question: When should a researcher engage research computing/data facilitators?
decisions.trigger: AI project is being proposed or scaled
decisions.context_variables: Sensitive data; GPUs; budget; cloud/local uncertainty; deployment; reproducibility
decisions.options: Required early consult for defined triggers | optional consult
decisions.recommendation_logic: Engage RCD before resource commitments, sensitive-data movement, GPU-heavy promises, or deployment choices.

decisions.question: Has the scientific question been translated into a feasible AI problem with success criteria?
decisions.trigger: Researcher proposes AI use
decisions.context_variables: Hypothesis; outcome; data; method; metrics; constraints
decisions.options: Proceed | refine problem | non-AI method may fit better
decisions.recommendation_logic: Define the research problem and success criteria before choosing models or infrastructure.
decisions.decision_output: Create one-page AI project problem statement.

decisions.question: What compute, storage, software, network and staffing resources does the project require?
decisions.trigger: Proposal, budget, or project kickoff
decisions.context_variables: Workload; data; timeline; model; scale; collaborators
decisions.options: Local resources | shared HPC | cloud | NAIRR/ACCESS | hybrid
decisions.recommendation_logic: Create resource plan before grant submission or major commitments.

decisions.question: Should the project use an existing model, fine-tune one, or develop a model from scratch?
decisions.trigger: AI approach selected
decisions.context_variables: Scientific need; data; licensing; compute; interpretability; budget
decisions.options: Use existing | fine-tune | train new
decisions.recommendation_logic: Start with existing/pretrained models unless research contribution or constraints require new training.

decisions.question: Do model and dataset licenses permit the intended research and deployment?
decisions.trigger: Using open or commercial models/datasets
decisions.context_variables: License; derivative works; commercial use; redistribution; publication
decisions.options: Proceed | choose alternative | seek permission
decisions.recommendation_logic: Review licenses before building around a model or dataset.

decisions.question: What benchmarks, baselines, metrics and acceptance criteria will determine whether the model is good enough?
decisions.trigger: Model is being developed or selected
decisions.context_variables: Domain standards; task; fairness; latency; cost; robustness
decisions.options: Domain benchmark | baseline comparison | project-specific criteria
decisions.recommendation_logic: Define evaluation before optimization and deployment; include performance, robustness, fairness and efficiency as relevant.

decisions.question: Which subgroups or contexts must be evaluated for disparate performance?
decisions.trigger: Model affects people or heterogeneous populations
decisions.context_variables: Population; domain; decision consequence; data representation
decisions.options: Subgroup metrics | stress tests | not applicable with rationale
decisions.recommendation_logic: Evaluate relevant groups where differential performance could cause harm or invalidate findings.

decisions.question: What must be versioned and documented so results can be reproduced?
decisions.trigger: AI research will be published, shared, or revisited
decisions.context_variables: Code; data; model; environment; parameters; hardware; randomness
decisions.options: Minimum reproducibility package | executable workflow | model card + data documentation
decisions.recommendation_logic: Version code/data/model artifacts and document environments and parameters.

decisions.question: What structured documentation should accompany an AI model or service?
decisions.trigger: Model is published, shared, or deployed
decisions.context_variables: Audience; risk; reuse; performance; limitations
decisions.options: Model card | fact sheet | datasheet | project report
decisions.recommendation_logic: Document intended use, performance, limitations, provenance, and evaluation.

decisions.question: Which datasets, code, models, and environments should be preserved after the project?
decisions.trigger: Project closes or results are published
decisions.context_variables: Sponsor; repository; privacy; reuse; storage; licensing
decisions.options: Deposit | controlled access | archive | delete
decisions.recommendation_logic: Plan preservation and controlled access alongside reproducibility and retention obligations.

decisions.question: Should the project use national/shared AI infrastructure rather than institutional resources?
decisions.trigger: Local resources are insufficient or specialized
decisions.context_variables: Eligibility; queue; data restrictions; support; cost; duration
decisions.options: NAIRR/ACCESS | institutional HPC | cloud | hybrid
decisions.recommendation_logic: Evaluate shared national resources before capital purchase for intermittent research demand.

decisions.question: Which administrative functions are already using or considering AI?
decisions.trigger: Staff use AI for work or vendors add automation
decisions.context_variables: HR; finance; admissions; advising; communications; research admin; facilities
decisions.options: Enterprise inventory | high-risk functions first
decisions.recommendation_logic: Identify use before automating or setting blanket rules.

decisions.question: May AI make or materially influence admissions, employment, financial aid, discipline, or other consequential decisions?
decisions.trigger: AI proposed in high-impact workflow
decisions.context_variables: Legal duties; bias; explainability; due process; human review
decisions.options: Decision support only | restricted automation | prohibit autonomous decision
decisions.recommendation_logic: Keep human decision authority and require enhanced review for consequential uses.
decisions.stakeholders: Legal; HR; Enrollment; Student affairs; Governance

decisions.question: Which steps of an administrative process are suitable for AI automation?
decisions.trigger: Unit seeks productivity gains
decisions.context_variables: Repetition; reversibility; data sensitivity; error cost; judgment
decisions.options: Automate low-risk steps | augment staff | redesign workflow | no AI
decisions.recommendation_logic: Automate tasks, not accountability; start with reversible low-risk work.
decisions.decision_output: Map workflow and approved automation boundary.

decisions.question: Which AI uses are appropriate in proposal development, compliance triage, reporting, and research development?
decisions.trigger: Research offices explore GenAI
decisions.context_variables: Sponsor policy; confidentiality; originality; staff workload
decisions.options: Draft assistance | summarization | workflow support | restricted sponsor materials
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use within sponsor/integrity constraints and retain human review.

decisions.question: When should chatbots or assistants be used for advising, service desks, or public information?
decisions.trigger: Unit proposes conversational AI
decisions.context_variables: Data access; accuracy; escalation; accessibility; hours; audience
decisions.options: FAQ bot | retrieval assistant | transactional bot | human-only
decisions.recommendation_logic: Start with bounded information tasks and explicit escalation; higher autonomy requires stronger controls.

decisions.question: How will operational AI be monitored for errors, drift, complaints, and business impact?
decisions.trigger: AI-supported workflow is live
decisions.context_variables: KPIs; error rate; complaint channels; model changes; owner
decisions.options: Continuous monitoring | periodic review | audit sample
decisions.recommendation_logic: Monitor both model behavior and process outcomes, with clear stop criteria.

decisions.question: What accessibility requirements apply to institutional AI tools and content?
decisions.trigger: AI tools are procured or required
decisions.context_variables: WCAG/VPAT; disability needs; multimodal use; alternative workflows
decisions.options: Institutional standard | product-specific remediation | alternative service
decisions.recommendation_logic: Apply accessibility requirements before broad deployment and include disability services in decisions.

decisions.question: How will users request and receive accommodations when AI is embedded in required workflows?
decisions.trigger: AI used in classes, employment, meetings, or student services
decisions.context_variables: Existing accommodation channels; tool limitations; alternatives
decisions.options: Existing office route | AI-specific escalation | alternative workflow
decisions.recommendation_logic: Integrate AI accommodations into existing disability-service processes and document alternatives.

decisions.question: Could the AI strategy deepen differences in access to tools, compute, training, or support?
decisions.trigger: Planning campus-wide AI services or curricula
decisions.context_variables: Licensing; device access; GPU access; paid tools; technical skill
decisions.options: Institution-funded access | shared infrastructure | targeted support | phased rollout
decisions.recommendation_logic: Treat equitable access as a design constraint, not a later benefit.

decisions.question: Do community or Indigenous data governance principles apply to the AI project?
decisions.trigger: Data concerns Tribal/Indigenous communities or governed knowledge
decisions.context_variables: CARE/OCAP/TK labels; consent; sovereignty; benefit sharing
decisions.options: Community governance process | restricted use | local control
decisions.recommendation_logic: Follow relevant community governance principles in addition to legal compliance.
decisions.stakeholders: Research; Community partners; Legal; Data stewards

decisions.question: How will shared AI resources and training opportunities be distributed fairly?
decisions.trigger: Scarce compute, licenses, fellowships, or training seats
decisions.context_variables: Department resources; research status; student access; grant funding
decisions.options: Transparent fair-share | targeted support | reservation pools
decisions.recommendation_logic: Use transparent rules and account for structural capacity differences.

decisions.question: How will the institution know whether an AI initiative is successful?
decisions.trigger: Pilot or program is launched
decisions.context_variables: Objective; baseline; users; cost; quality; risk; equity
decisions.options: Outcome metrics | adoption metrics | efficiency | quality | risk | mix
decisions.recommendation_logic: Tie measures to the original institutional or research objective, not usage alone.

decisions.question: What must an AI pilot test before scaling?
decisions.trigger: New AI service/use case begins
decisions.context_variables: Users; risk; integration; support; accessibility; cost; outcomes
decisions.options: Technical + user + risk + cost evaluation
decisions.recommendation_logic: Design pilots to answer scale decisions, with exit criteria and accountable owners.
decisions.stakeholders: Program owner; IT; Users; governance body

decisions.question: At what points should a project stop, redesign, or proceed?
decisions.trigger: AI project has material cost or risk
decisions.context_variables: Milestones; acceptance criteria; compliance; cost; model quality
decisions.options: Proceed | redesign | stop | seek exception
decisions.recommendation_logic: Define go/no-go points before sunk costs accumulate.

decisions.question: How will deployed models be checked for performance degradation or changed behavior?
decisions.trigger: Model or AI service remains in use over time
decisions.context_variables: Metrics; vendor model changes; data shift; user complaints
decisions.options: Automated monitoring | periodic benchmark | vendor change review
decisions.recommendation_logic: Re-test after material model/data changes and monitor performance appropriate to impact.

decisions.question: What happens when a vendor silently changes the underlying model or feature?
decisions.trigger: Using SaaS AI with evolving models
decisions.context_variables: Contract notice; benchmark suite; critical workflows; rollback
decisions.options: Revalidation | change freeze for critical use | alternate provider
decisions.recommendation_logic: Treat material model changes as configuration changes requiring proportionate revalidation.

decisions.question: How will usage, compute, storage, API, egress, and staffing costs be monitored over time?
decisions.trigger: AI service has variable or growing cost
decisions.context_variables: Unit costs; budgets; chargeback; utilization
decisions.options: Dashboards | budget alerts | quota | periodic TCO review
decisions.recommendation_logic: Monitor variable AI costs and compare against measured value.

decisions.question: When should an AI service, model, or pilot be retired?
decisions.trigger: AI assets persist after need declines
decisions.context_variables: Usage; cost; risk; replacement; data retention; owner
decisions.options: Retire | replace | archive | continue
decisions.recommendation_logic: Define retirement and secure decommissioning criteria as part of launch.
decisions.stakeholders: Service owner; IT; Records; Data governance
